title: MATKP Phenotypes
bodyHtml:
This page provides genetic and pathway correlations for adipose-relevant phenotypes. The genetic associations are generated by bottom-line integrative meta-analysis of Genome-Wide Association Studies (GWAS) from the Association to Function Knowledge Portal (A2FKP). Functional annotations are derived from the Common Metabolic Diseases Genome Atlas (CMDGA). Begin by searching a phenotype below. 

Explore MATKP to learn more about adipose tissue-relevant datasets, gene information, cell type expression, or differential gene expression in various conditions. Contribute to the growing body of adipose-related knowledge by submitting your data to the MATKP here.
